lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills arranged in distinct vertical columns, creating a repeating grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular spot columns to form anchor nodes within the lateral grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges running along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: At least 12 distinct high-luminance blobs scattered across the leading and middle sections of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and tissue loss on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; additional irregularities visible on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral region below the pectoral fin.
